title: Alex Evans at Umbra Ignite 2015: Learning From Failure
summary: Media Molecule's Alex Evans recounts the journey, including the failures, of finding the Dreams engine, based on his Siggraph 2015 talk. It covers the signed-distance-field and splat-based rendering approach and the artistic goals behind it.
why: HN calls it an inspirational must-see on SDF rendering and a favorite tech talk for graphics programmers.

quote.text: the Dreams presentation which is an inspirational must see
